metadata.title: UNESCO NeuroAI Evidence-Depth and Observatory Integration
metadata.status: COMPLETE WITHIN DECLARED SOURCE UNIVERSES; GLOBAL COMPLETENESS AND EXTERNAL APPRAISAL NOT CLAIMED
metadata.north_star: A global NeuroAI observatory and evidence-and-decision infrastructure that maps the ecosystem, evaluates exact systems, exposes unresolved evidence and supports bounded institutional action.

methodology.title: Phase IIIB Evidence-Depth Completion Protocol
methodology.completion_definition: Complete within explicitly declared source universes; no claim of exhaustive global discovery.

source_universes.unit: active organization records inherited from v1.3 plus the frozen regional-expansion list
source_universes.closure: Every open v1.3 record adjudicated and every addition source-tagged.

source_universes.unit: capital and ownership events found in the frozen official primary-source set
source_universes.closure: Every included event has date, parties, amount state, source and decision boundary.

source_universes.unit: 13 inherited representative records plus five declared model/dataset registries or audits
source_universes.closure: Every registry reports its own denominator and limitation.

source_universes.unit: trial-site relations explicitly named in selected official developer and controlled pilot sources
source_universes.closure: No site inferred from organizational existence.

source_universes.unit: participant powers documented in three controlled pilots plus the Neuralink registry
source_universes.closure: Every relationship distinguishes operational, consent, registry and governance authority.

source_universes.unit: technical dependencies supported by the three pilots and selected official product descriptions
source_universes.closure: Supplier capability is not represented as a system-specific contract unless evidenced.
